description: This PHP class defines a Resource object for handling oEmbed resources within Drupal, including methods for creating different resource types (link, photo, rich, video) and accessing their properties.

classes.name: Resource
classes.description: Represents an oEmbed resource with properties like type, provider, title, author, thumbnail, dimensions, and HTML content. Includes factory methods for creating specific resource types and getters for accessing properties.

methods.name: link
methods.description: Creates a link resource with optional URL, provider, title, author, cache age, and thumbnail details.

methods.name: photo
methods.description: Creates a photo resource with URL, dimensions, provider, author, cache age, and thumbnail details.

methods.name: rich
methods.description: Creates a rich resource with HTML content, dimensions, provider, author, cache age, and thumbnail details.

methods.name: video
methods.description: Creates a video resource with HTML content, dimensions, provider, author, cache age, and thumbnail details.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the resource type (link, photo, rich, video).

methods.name: getAuthorName
methods.description: Returns the name of the resource's author.

methods.name: getAuthorUrl
methods.description: Returns the absolute URL of the resource's author.

methods.name: getThumbnailUrl
methods.description: Returns the absolute URL of the thumbnail image.

methods.name: getThumbnailWidth
methods.description: Returns the thumbnail width in pixels.

methods.name: getThumbnailHeight
methods.description: Returns the thumbnail height in pixels.

methods.name: getWidth
methods.description: Returns the resource width in pixels.

methods.name: getHeight
methods.description: Returns the resource height in pixels.

methods.name: getUrl
methods.description: Returns the absolute URL of the resource (for 'photo' and 'link' types).

methods.name: getHtml
methods.description: Returns the HTML content of the resource (for 'rich' and 'video' types).

methods.name: setThumbnailDimensions
methods.description: Sets the thumbnail width and height, validating they are greater than zero.

methods.name: setDimensions
methods.description: Sets the resource width and height, validating they are greater than zero or NULL.
